text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Daitaku Helios invited me along 
to visit a shrine, but—
choice_data_list: By the way, why a shrine?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yesterday Fukukitaru told me 
something like, "You feat. God it up"?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My motivation's been kinda meh-talos 
lately, so I figured I'd drop by for a 
prayer! Or whatevs☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa!? Hold up! Over there! Isn't 
there something there!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Daitaku Helios 
pointed— there definitely was "something" 
there.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yaaay♪ Mister? Miss? What's the matter~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nhaha, I have no clue what you're saying! 
Umyonyopi? Pi?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice! The vibe is peak, FOO~♪ 
Honestly, we're basically besties already☆ 
So anyway—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having made a new friend, 
Daitaku Helios completely regained her 
groove.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the intense light that engulfed the 
shrine cleared, whatever that "thing" was 
had vanished without a trace!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, major bummer~~! And here I thought 
I'd make more besties~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having failed to make a new friend, 
Daitaku Helios remained out of sorts 
afterward...
